title: 设置入口图标
intendedUse: 游戏大厅的设置入口，不包含文字和状态标记
prompt: Create a transparent-background polished stylized 3D casual-game settings icon: one rounded deep-teal gear with a warm-ivory circular center and a small warm-gold inset accent. Match the supplied reference's rounded enamel-like volume, softly beveled edges, controlled highlights, and upper-left light. Keep the tooth count simple and silhouette bold; center with transparent padding, readable at 64 px.
negativePrompt: thin technical outline, flat vector, photorealism, text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, clutter, many tiny gear teeth

visualReferenceImages.purpose: Rendering material, palette, bevel highlights and lighting only.
